title: Conectores
description: And, but, or, because, so, although, however… con ejemplos.

rows: I'm tired because I worked late.
It was raining, so we stayed in.
Although it was cold, we went out.
If it rains, we'll stay at home.
I listen to music while I cook.
antes de que / después de que
Wash your hands before you eat.
It's expensive. However, it's very good.
